class.name: FeaturePlugin
class.brief_description: Base class for a redesigned engine feature plugin.
class.description: FeaturePlugin provides metadata and lifecycle hooks for optional engine features. Plugins can be implemented in GDScript or native code and registered with FeaturePluginManager.

method.name: initialize
method.description: Called when the plugin is initialized.

method.name: shutdown
method.description: Called when the plugin is disabled or removed.

method.name: process
method.description: Called each frame when the host processes plugins.
